name: 04-scenario-testing
description: The scenario suite driving the real device while you watch, card by card in the order the interface lists them.

steps.title: Tested the way you use it
steps.caption: Tested the way you use it. Eleven scenarios, one real device.
A scenario is a JSON file of steps, performed against a running device over the same API this page uses.

steps.name: suite
steps.caption: The suite starts, and runs the cards in the order they are listed here.
Control: a fader is aimed at the brightness, moved, and proven to drive it.
Layouts: the grid grows and shrinks while it renders, reallocating mid-frame.
Effects: the pipeline is built from nothing, then an effect is swapped in its slot.
Drivers: the master switch blacks the output without losing the brightness behind it.
System: it names the device, restarts it, and checks the name came back.
File Manager: a file is written, the device restarts, and the file is read back.
Network: mDNS and the WLED shim, each proven to survive a restart.
Services: audio is synthesized by default, so the effects react with nothing attached.
MoonCloud: consent is off until someone says otherwise, which is what this one asserts.

steps.name: suite
steps.caption: Every scenario runs against the device rather than a mock, so a pass means it worked here.
Eleven scenarios, all passed, on the device still running in front of you.
